findings.claim: ADR 0029's change was a bullet inside Consequences instead of an appended correction section.
No .okf/log.md line named the two hand-edited concepts.
Two edited lines ran past 80 columns.

verdict.text: All three round 1 findings are fixed and the fixes broke nothing.
The code is unchanged since round 1, and the gates are green on the new tree.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: pass pre_commit, pass cli_tests, pass r1, pass r2, stamp green 59cee8a6966772ce321a4b46538f3d6a7fd8d83f43316c4523bc84b007487bdf.
Read the diff of ADR 0029, `.okf/log.md`, `.okf/components/bifrost.md` and `deployments/applications/services.tf` against main, and scanned every added line for length over 80 columns.
ADR 0029 now ends with `## Correction, 2026-11-16`, the Consequences bullet is gone, and the diff against main touches only the appended section, so the Decision text is as written.
The correction states the new priorities, why (the boot error from the hand-made rules at 0 to 3) and why the decision still holds.
`.okf/log.md` gains one line naming `decisions/0029-...` and `components/bifrost` with the reason.
The bifrost.md paragraph and the services.tf comment are rewrapped.
The services.tf comment is outside any heredoc or jobspec, so it changes no state.
The only long added lines left are the unbreakable ADR link line in bifrost.md, the log line (log.md lines are one per entry and already run long), and JSON in bifrost.hcl, all acceptable.
